An Ode to the Endeavour Space Shuttle

I’m standing on the floor of the Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center of the California Science Center under the tail of the new exhibit of the Space Shuttle Endeavour and remembering how I felt looking up at that same shuttle on the launch pad at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
